issue.title: bob ref meet: Mac-only Wispr Flow local-store notes adapter, schema-probed and doctor-gated
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Add a Mac-only Wispr Flow local-store adapter so `bob ref meet` (and Bob Mac Capture's Meeting Notes sheet) can read a meeting's notes from Wispr's local store, not only from the clipboard. The store is undocumented, so the adapter must probe the schema before reading, report its health through `bob ref doctor`, and degrade to the clipboard/file contract when the probe fails.

Source: the "Deferred" section of plan:202611/meeting_notes_event_refs.md (epic bob-cli-pw).
